positions.title: Sr. Database Administrator
positions.requirementSummary: Sr. Database Administrator needed w/Master's degree or Foreign Equivalent in Business Analytics or Computer Information Systems or Computer Science or Computer Engineering and one (1) year experience as Sr. Database Administrator or Database Administrator performing following job duties:
positions.dutiesParagraph: Ensure the integrity, security, HIPAA-compliant protection of enterprise and patient data through access controls, encryption, backups, continuous monitoring across servers, databases and data transfers.  Design, maintain and optimize pharmacy databases and integrations with EHR, POS, inventory, billing, Micro Merchant, Medistics, 340B (Cumulus) and DME platforms, while troubleshooting performance, connectivity and data issues.   Create and maintain the database schema, including tables, indexes, views and relationships to efficiently store pharmacy data such as patient information, prescriptions, inventory and billing.  Ensure seamless data integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR), Point of Sale (POS) systems and inventory management systems.
